build_auto_model_from_pretrained: build an auto model from a pretrained model name or path using AutoModel.from_pretrained
create_model_from_config: create a model instance from a PreTrainedConfig object using from_config method
register_model_class: register a new model class for a config class in the auto model mapping
add_generation_mixin_to_remote_model: add GenerationMixin inheritance to a remote model class loaded with trust_remote_code
build_timm_backbone_from_pretrained: build a timm backbone model from pretrained weights using AutoBackbone.from_pretrained
